decisions.statement: A path under a page name goes by the change taking the files beside it away.
Every other TypeScript path goes by the change judging the imports named.
Every other path goes by the change taking the file alone away.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
Nothing here reads a path for its kind.
A path under a page type name goes by the change taking a page type away.
A path under a page property name goes by the change taking a page property away.

definition: one file taken away, through the change taking that kind of path away
